narrative:
Material PL1__M290AAB3 exhibits moderate demand variability (CV=25.2%) with no significant trend, 
but highly erratic lead time (CV=52.9%). The current safety stock of 669 units is insufficient 
to achieve the 95% service level target given the lead time volatility. 

The recommended safety stock of 1492 units (increase of 823 units or 
123%) is driven primarily by lead time variability, which contributes 
87% of the total demand-during-lead-time variance. The optimized order quantity of 9158 
units balances ordering and holding costs while respecting the MOQ of 200 units and storage capacity of 
14728 units.

The recommended policy saves $62,614.45 annually, 
but is necessary to protect against stockouts given the supply chain variability.
warnings: High lead time variability (CV=52.90%) requires close supplier monitoring
Safety stock increase of 123% may require budget approval

research_insights.selected_model: Classical (Q,R) model with stochastic lead time
research_insights.selection_rationale: Moderate demand variability (CV=25.25%) and erratic lead time (CV=52.90%) necessitate robust buffer sizing
research_insights.boundary_risk: Lead time is the dominant source of variance (87%), requiring supplier performance focus
